--- results.md
## Disposition
CONFIRMED

## Interpretation
The unauthenticated request returned another tenant's row while the own-tenant control returned only own rows; the differential reproduced twice with a clean negative control.

--- results.md
## Disposition
FALSE_POSITIVE

## Interpretation
The 403 was a WAF challenge, not an authorization decision: the same request with a browser user agent succeeded, the application log shows no authorization check, and the response body is the edge block page.

--- results.md
## Disposition
NEGATIVE

## Interpretation
The secure behavior held: every crafted request was denied with the same generic error, including the control-shaped payload; the negative control was clean and no bypass was observed.

--- results.md
## Disposition
INCONCLUSIVE

## Interpretation
The run timed out before any response arrived and the retry hit a rate limit; no observation either way, so the question is not decided.
